notes: A housekeeping update — nothing on screen changes. The app now tells the company which version it is running, so HR can see who is up to date and who still needs to install a new build. Everything from the last release is included: your location is needed to check in or out, and the app asks for it before opening the camera so you are never made to take a selfie only to be told the punch cannot be saved; being outside the office range still does not block a punch, it is only flagged. Uploading documents accepts PDFs and any image up to 10 MB, and every password box has an eye to show what you are typing.
